comp_analysis.reasoning: Strongest architectural comparison and same west-city market. Subject has substantially more above-grade space, another bedroom and full bath, and a larger apparent parcel, supporting an upward adjustment. Subject's older construction and built-under garage offset some of those advantages. Subject has less finished basement area. The adjusted indication is approximate; paired-sale adjustment rates are unavailable.

Very close and recently sold, providing strong location and timing evidence. Its larger wooded parcel, grade-level three-car garage, ranch layout and greater finished basement area support a downward adjustment. Subject's larger above-grade area, fourth bedroom, additional full bath and more updated described finishes offset part of that difference. Its distinct design and utility reduce comparability.

Similar colonial design, construction era and bedroom count. Subject's above-grade area alone exceeds this comp's reported total finished area; its larger apparent parcel, additional half bath and greater garage capacity support an upward adjustment. Unverified floor-area allocation and unrecovered interior photographs limit the reliability and magnitude of that adjustment.

result.rationale: Three completed 2026 sales support a provisional market-value range. The colonial comparisons indicate upward adjustments from their sale prices, while the nearby ranch provides an upper reference requiring a net downward adjustment for its land and garage advantages. Rounded reconciliation supports approximately $595,000, with a broad $565,000–$625,000 range reflecting incomplete comparability and condition verification. The 2017 subject sale is too old to translate into current value without market-trend evidence and receives no numerical weight.
assumptions: The supplied sales are completed, arm's-length transactions without material undisclosed concessions.
Subject area, room counts and municipal utilities are substantially accurate.
Approximately 0.536 acres is used as the provisional parcel area; the larger listing acreage is not credited.
No material concealed structural, water-intrusion or mechanical defect exists beyond the disclosed uncertainty.
No quantified market-time adjustment is applied because supporting trend evidence was not supplied.
missing_evidence: Verified sale concessions and transaction circumstances for all comparables.
Additional recent colonial sales with similar above-grade area, lot size and built-under garages.
Verified above-grade and below-grade area allocation and interior condition for C3.
Survey confirming exclusive parcel area and boundaries.
Inspection of foundation, retaining walls, deck, steps, garage and updated bathroom waterproofing.
Independent documentation of roof and HVAC replacements and local market trends through the valuation date.

receipt.limitations: Fresh-context, packet-only instructions and exposure attestations; shared Work tools/files are not access-isolated. Hashes detect changes, not proof of blindness.
